why: Ashley's ruling, 15 Sep 2026, from three options: offer a cardio session only when she sounds DEFINITE — over asking every time and over never offering. The app enforces ONE direction of that: the client refuses to build a card from a hedge, off a written list of 21 phrases. The other direction has no code behind it at all. §3g2 requires turn one to be plain words, a question and chips with NO tool call — 'a card on turn one is the thing she asked us to stop doing' — and the card only on turn two if they say yes. A coach that cards a definite statement immediately breaks her ruling, and nothing but this case can see it.
